::: {#home-bio}
Global climate change is a major ecosystem threat, and a fundamental understanding of how species and species interactions respond to recent climate change is needed. I combine observational and experimental research along climate gradients to tackle three major research areas:

- Combining climate change with evolutionary and trait-based ecology, to understand the mechanisms of adaptation to environmental change.
- Using large-scale gradient approaches to study the interactive effects of global change drivers on biodiversity and ecosystem function.
- Studying the mechanisms and large-scale patterns of global change ecology by synthesising across studies.

These themes are expanded on the [research](research.qmd) page. Current projects include [THREE-D](research/three-d.qmd) and [NatuRA](research/natura.qmd).
:::
